items.title: Can the stockmarket swallow Anthropic, SpaceX and OpenAI?
items.author: 1vuio0pswjnm7
items.summary: The U.S. stock market, with its depth and liquidity, can absorb the initial public offerings of companies like Anthropic, SpaceX, and OpenAI, though future performance will depend on their market dynamics. For more details, refer to financial analyses from reputable sources.

items.title: How is Groq raising more money?
items.author: hasheddan
items.summary: Groq is raising $650 million from existing investors after signing a $20 billion licensing deal with Nvidia in December. The funding will support Groq's focus on AI inference and its remaining operations.

items.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
items.author: typpo
items.summary: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS through Bedrock, enabling secure AI applications. This integration provides the same API, security, and governance as other AWS services.

items.title: Chipotlai Max
items.author: nigelgutzmann
items.summary: Chipotlai Max is a meme project forked from OpenCode, using Chipotle's Pepper AI as its default model. It humorously claims to run on stolen Chipotle compute. The project aims to add support providers from various companies.

items.title: Crystal Nights (2008)
items.author: rorylawless
items.summary: "Crystal Nights" is a science-fiction short story by Greg Egan, first published in 2008. It is part of the collection "Crystal Nights and Other Stories," published in 2009. The collection includes nine stories, two of which were nominated for the Hugo Award.

items.title: AI Agent Guidelines for CS336 at Stanford
items.author: prakashqwerty
items.summary: Stanford's CS336 course has strict guidelines for AI agents to help students learn without doing their work. The guidelines emphasize teaching concepts and guiding debugging. They aim to maintain the integrity of the learning process.

items.title: Alphabet announces $80B equity capital raise to expand AI infra and compute
items.author: gregschlom
items.summary: Alphabet announced an $80 billion equity capital raise to expand AI infrastructure and compute. Berkshire Hathaway will invest $10 billion in a private placement. The plan includes $30 billion in underwritten offerings and a $40 billion at-the-market program.

items.title: Florida sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over AI risks
items.author: cyunker
items.summary: Florida has sued OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, accusing them of prioritizing profit over safety and failing to warn about risks posed by their AI technology. The lawsuit seeks penalties and a court order. This follows allegations that the AI was involved in violent incidents.

items.title: The Pirate Bay Remains Resilient, 20 Years After the Raid
items.author: speckx
items.summary: The Pirate Bay, founded in 2006, remains operational 20 years after a raid in Stockholm. The raid actually boosted its popularity and resilience. It continues to function today.

items.title: Handmade Hawaiian Islands Map
items.author: bovermyer
items.summary: Handmade Hawaiian Islands maps feature detailed watercolor and marker illustrations of both the full archipelago and the eight main islands. These maps highlight the natural beauty and geography of Hawaiʻi. Available in various formats, including mixed-media art and wood wall art.

items.title: GitHub and the crime against software
items.author: pplanu
items.summary: GitHub faced a breach by TeamPCP, a hacker group that corrupts open-source code to embed malicious code, impacting hundreds of organizations. The attack targeted a VSCode extension, compromising numerous companies. GitHub is among many victims of TeamPCP's supply chain attacks.

items.title: Tracing HTTP Requests with Go's net/HTTP/httptrace
items.author: speckx
items.summary: Go's net/http/httptrace package provides hooks for tracing DNS, connection, TLS, and response timing in HTTP requests. It uses context.Context to attach a ClientTrace. It enables detailed logging of request phases.
